Tests and characterization should protect observable contracts, invariants, boundary values, state transitions, failure and resource paths, and repaired regressions at the smallest level that can observe them without binding to irrelevant internals.

Production credentials are high-value secrets requiring dedicated custody - kept out of source control, images, and installation directories; readable only by the owning account or held in a vault whose decryption keys live elsewhere; expunged from process memory promptly; and excluded from core dumps and support bundles.
